must.title: Security
must.description: Ensure the system is secure against common vulnerabilities.
must.metric: Pass OWASP Top Ten security tests.
acceptance_criteria: No critical vulnerabilities are found in security assessments.
Security tests cover all OWASP Top Ten vulnerabilities.
Regular security audits are conducted post-deployment.
must.verification: Conduct SAST and DAST scans; perform penetration testing.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: The system must be reliable and available 99.9% of the time.
acceptance_criteria: Automated monitoring alerts on any downtime.
Incident response procedures are in place and tested.
must.verification: Monitor system uptime and perform regular reliability tests.

should.title: Performance
should.description: The system must handle peak loads without performance degradation.
should.metric: Handle 1000 concurrent users with response time < 2 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: System response time is under 2 seconds for 1000 concurrent users.
Performance tests show no significant degradation under load.
Resource utilization is within acceptable limits during peak usage.
should.verification: Load test at 1000 concurrent users; measure response times and resource usage.

should.title: Scalability
should.description: The system must scale to accommodate future growth.
should.metric: Support 200% increase in user base without performance loss.
acceptance_criteria: Performance remains stable with increased user load.
Scalability tests confirm system can handle 200% user growth.
should.verification: Conduct scalability tests with simulated user growth scenarios.

should.title: Usability
should.description: Ensure the system is user-friendly and intuitive.
should.metric: User satisfaction score of 8/10 or higher.
acceptance_criteria: User feedback indicates high satisfaction with the new interface.
Usability tests show improved task completion times.
Training materials are updated and accessible to all users.
should.verification: Conduct user satisfaction surveys and usability testing.
